classifications.source_derived_reference: Source-derived research/reference without independent validation of the entire detail.

limitations: All95PDF pages and all29chapters reviewed, with five section dividers retained. Four contact sheets cover all pages; twelve selected pages inspected at full-page scale. No field or pulse testing.
PDF1 cover is visually unnumbered despite hidden text-layer0. PDF2-95 have printed=PDF-1, no reset. Image-only filter/trap details are visual paraphrases, not complete technical plans.
Army credentials and claimed exact protocols are unverified. Publication title/copyright are distinct from PDF author metadata.

CISA2019guidelines are historical engineering guidance, not certification of this book, a retail product or a household. A phone/Wi-Fi reception check is not broadband EMP qualification. No attenuation or pulse-withstand result was measured.
A protected spare is different from an actively needed medical device. No interruption of therapy, live electrical work or automatic task/goal creation is authorized.
No complete EMP shield, generator/solar restoration procedure, water treatment device, preservation recipe, clinical honey use, fish trap or building design is verified.
Page55violent retaking tactics are recorded only as a high-level excluded claim, without operational source components; they are not app task/goal candidates.
Verified labels apply only to the exact constrained reviewed principle; evidence-backed corrections do not verify the original broad claim. Other useful research references are not necessarily false.

No site-specific water quality/yield, power/load/runtime, radio coverage/licensing, permits, livestock or crop budget was assessed. The household’s irrigation well remains unassigned to potable or outage supply.

The seven-book app package, authoritative core, examination schema and prior reviews remain unchanged; Books8-10 are packaged separately for the app agent after validation. Root-cellar construction remains deferred.
